title: Witness sketch of cigar-shaped object on Henry Grady Hotel stationery (Fig. 7)
description: Photographic reproduction of a hand sketch drawn on "HENRY GRADY HOTEL" letterhead, showing an elongated, segmented cigar-shaped object with lines or streamers trailing from its top end and a pointed lower tip. Handwritten notes appear along both margins and a small separate oval sketch appears at upper right. Captioned "Fig. 7".
